title: Chat threads saved in the drawer, /chats endpoints, ask-first delete (0.6.12, T21 PR 1)
head: t21-chat-storage
body:
## Summary

- Drawer files: `chats/<id>.jsonl` + `index.json` via private-file primitives
- `/chats` list, create, get, search, append, rename endpoints
- Delete is ask-first with preview + one-time token bound to the thread and its content
- `WS /chat send` takes optional `thread_id`; no id = newest thread; `done` echoes `thread_id`
- Search is local text match, never sent to the model; model input unchanged

## Tests

- Resume after restart keeps the thread
- Delete pauses for a yes: no token deletes nothing; replayed/wrong/stale token = 409
- Coordinator mutation-tested the delete gate: accepting any token, skipping the content check, or deleting on preview each fail a test
